title: AgentMisalignmentMini: A Lightweight Replication of Agent Misalignment Evaluation for Small Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: agent misalignment with deployer intentions is a critical emerging safety problem. Making evaluation accessible to the student community enables broader study of the phenomenon on smaller, more inspectable models.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reformulating 30-40 scenarios as direct-response tasks and evaluating small models is moderately accessible. Running under different RLHF configurations adds complexity, but the 8-hour GPU constraint and focus on smaller models help.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 30-40 scenarios, two model variants, multiple RLHF configurations, and a deployer deviation score. Could be narrowed to a single model with 2 configurations to fit 30 hours.

novelty.reasoning: No novelty assessment available; default estimated score assigned.
